lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, displaying a grid-like topology with spacing increasing towards the posterior edge of the frame.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form localized anchor points, most prominent in the transition zone between the head and the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible above the gills, defined by a sharp luminance transition from a superior highlight to an inferior shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, small-scale spotting pattern on the proximal section of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the adjacent flank.
